objectives.title: Improve Psionic
objectives.intent: Make native inference faster, support more model families, and support more device types while preserving each workload's correctness requirements.
outcomes: Increase decode tokens per second and improve prefill or time to first token for currently supported models.
Add a licensed model family with tokenizer, template, numerical checks, and a qualified inference path.
Add or improve a device backend with a real model run on the target hardware.
measurements: Paired baseline and candidate on the same model artifact, precision, device, prompt/output lengths, concurrency, warm-up, and build configuration.
Decode tokens per second, affected prefill latency, time to first token, peak memory, and correctness results.
candidate_examples: Profile a supported model and remove one measured allocation, transfer, synchronization, or kernel bottleneck.
Find a repeated unsupported-model or device gap and qualify the smallest useful extension.
constraints: Use the separate crates/psionic/Cargo.toml workspace and its applicable instructions.
Keep lossy quantization evidence separate from optimizations that preserve correctness.
Use isolated benchmark processes; do not stop production model processes or Pylons.

objectives.title: Improve Kiln
objectives.intent: Make Kiln reliably turn bounded coding tasks into checked, reviewable changes, including persistent execution without an open browser tab.
outcomes: Persist and resume the shared agent loop, workspace, pending calls, and task history across native host restarts.
Improve coding success, tool reliability, context use, and the time from task start to a checked patch.
Add qualified workspace and device runner profiles, and reliable patch-to-draft-PR delivery.
measurements: Independently checked task success, steps, model/tool/test time, and exact patch/check/PR identities.
Recovery outcomes after interruption, stale checks refused, and duplicate runs or PRs prevented.
candidate_examples: Drive kiln::agent from a persistent Rust host using the existing loop and runner contracts.
Add one explicit nested-workspace runner profile with boundary and stale-check fixtures.
constraints: Keep Foreman's objective selection separate from Kiln execution and runner verification.
Preserve runner path, command, quota, and identity checks.
Task execution does not grant Kiln's admin self-publish or revert permissions.

objectives.title: Improve Pylon
objectives.intent: Make model service through Pylons more reliable, faster, and easier to operate on the devices and capacity already available.
outcomes: Improve discovery, model matching, placement, and truthful capacity reporting.
Recover cleanly from busy peers, lost connections, expired deadlines, and failed model processes.
Reduce routing overhead and end-to-end latency, and improve throughput on existing hardware.
measurements: Successful verified requests, first-contact and end-to-end latency distributions, throughput, and queue time under matched workloads.
Timeout, refusal, recovery, and unknown-outcome rates with request and result identities retained.
candidate_examples: Reproduce and fix one routing or reconnect failure with bounded transport fixtures.
Measure a bottleneck between buyer admission and the model call, then remove it.
constraints: Read the Nostr skill and applicable NIPs before changing protocol behavior.
A timeout does not authorize replaying an uncertain effect or claiming that a peer completed work.
Do not change paid admission, spend limits, or running production services without the required authority.

objectives.title: Improve Coder
objectives.intent: Help Coder complete more real coding tasks correctly, recover interrupted work, and provide clear evidence for review.
outcomes: Increase independently verified coding-task completion and reduce failed tool or harness interactions.
Improve restart, cancellation, handoff, and resume behavior without duplicate effects or lost work.
Improve targeted verification, usable progress reporting, and evidence attached to a delivery.
measurements: Verified task success, time to a checked delivery, model/tool usage, and failure or recovery counts on a fixed task set.
Regressions in permissions, cancellation, host/account isolation, and exact retry behavior.
candidate_examples: Turn a repeated real task failure into a regression fixture and fix the responsible runtime path.
Remove a measured source of unnecessary tool calls or rebuilds without reducing verification coverage.
constraints: Preserve tool permissions, independent checks, account isolation, and durable task history.
Read the release brief before changes to Coder or its server routes; release publication remains with the release agent.
Do not add another session, transport, or task implementation alongside an existing one.

objectives.title: Improve Microcoder
objectives.intent: Complete more independently verified coding tasks with less inference, time, and cost, using small models and useful decisions where measurements support them.
outcomes: Improve success on held-out tasks and reduce wasted repair steps or repeated tool failures.
Improve repository context selection, decision use, and model routing with attributable measurements.
Reduce cost and latency per verified result while retaining independent verification.
measurements: Verified successes, cost and wall time per success, tokens, repair steps, and fallback frequency on paired fixed tasks.
Every attempt's result, including failure, cancellation, timeout, and unknown cost.
candidate_examples: Study a repeated held-out failure and improve the smallest context, tool, or repair behavior responsible.
Compare a decision or routing change with the existing baseline under the same task and resource limits.
constraints: Do not weaken verifiers, train on protected evaluation cases, or compare only successful attempts.
Read the TypeSafe and decision API skills before changing question sets, thresholds, or decision clients.
A cheaper failed run is not an improvement in cost per verified result.

objectives.title: Improve Foreman
objectives.intent: Turn eligible issues and standing objectives into useful checked deliveries with reliable follow-up and no duplicate work.
outcomes: Improve objective selection, evidence-backed task discovery, stall recovery, and continuity across restarts.
measurements: Time to checked delivery, stall minutes, duplicate tasks or PRs, recovery results, and missed check-ins.
candidate_examples: Replay an observed coordination failure and fix the smallest host or selection behavior that would have prevented it.
constraints: Foreman cannot broaden its own grants, replace its acceptance checks, or hide failures by changing its metrics.

objectives.title: Improve Gym
objectives.intent: Make agent and model improvements easier to reproduce, compare fairly, and reject when the evidence does not support them.
outcomes: Improve regression coverage, paired measurements, failure analysis, and reproducibility of published results.
measurements: Replay agreement, incomplete evidence detected, paired outcome differences, and time to reproduce a result.
candidate_examples: Capture a real evaluation reproducibility gap and add the missing evidence or check.
constraints: Preserve evaluation partitions and immutable results; never lower a gate to make a candidate pass.

objectives.title: Improve OpenAgents
objectives.intent: Make the shared chat and coding experience more reliable and understandable across desktop, phone, and web.
outcomes: Improve message delivery, visible progress, reconnect behavior, and consistent shared controls.
measurements: Reproduced user-flow failures fixed, end-to-end latency, reconnect outcomes, and accessibility checks on affected surfaces.
candidate_examples: Reproduce one confusing or broken chat flow and fix it through the existing shared Rust domain and view layers.
constraints: Keep domain logic in Rust and shared cards in Rust Native; do not add TypeScript or duplicate domain implementations.
Use an admitted device for device-only checks; do not interrupt the owner's live chats or test on the owner's account.
